text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: The swelling you describe as "fixed" and painless is a concerning sign of malignancy; regarding your history, do you have any known history of alcohol use or recent infections? REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and LDH. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal ultrasound and Chest CT.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: WBC: Elevated, Hemoglobin: Slightly Decreased, Platelets: Normal; Lactate Dehydrogenase: Elevated; CT Scan Findings: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes; Biopsy Findings: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL).
